name: GLroad Robotics
name_zh: 武汉格蓝若智能机器人有限公司
summary: GLroad Robotics is a Wuhan-based robot developer and manufacturer within the GLroad group. It works with Chen Xuedong's team at Huazhong University of Science and Technology on humanoid robot development and technology transfer. Its Laborer family targets physically demanding work and power-infrastructure inspection, with additional biped, quadruped and wheeled robot platforms under development.
